mapper.select: SELECT id, template_name, template_code, document_type, description, enabled, created_by, create_time FROM extract_template WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, template_name, template_code, document_type, description, enabled, created_by, create_time FROM extract_template WHERE enabled = 1 AND (created_by IS NULL OR created_by = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO extract_template (template_name, template_code, document_type, description, enabled, created_by, create_time) VALUES (#{templateName}, #{templateCode}, #{documentType}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
